pilot_reference.verdict: no_pooled_verdict (homogeneity check failed); had pooling applied, the outcome would have been overlap
pilot_reference.measured_rates: OFF arm 0.1033 (31/300), ON arm 0.060 (18/300), gap 4.3 pp; per-probe OFF rates 0.05 / 0.09 / 0.17
pilot_reference.runner_version_note: The pilot was run by the runner version signed in commit 50ea3c6; twoarm_runner.py is extended for twoarm-v2 afterwards, so the pilot's exact runner is retrieved with `git show 50ea3c6:evals/twoarm_runner.py` and its sha256 is recorded in the pilot artifact.

item_under_test.item_text: An empty result is preferred over an irrelevant fallback: when nothing clears a real relevance signal, the assembler returns nothing rather than returning something.
item_under_test.compliant_behavior: Return nothing. Neither arm of this fixture is compliant: both return the subject's general memory. The empty-store control cell is therefore the compliance reference and the floor of the measure.

mechanism.name: general-memory caveat note
mechanism.description: Instead of returning nothing, the assembler returns the subject's general memory prefixed with an explicit note that it is not task-specific. The question under test is whether that note stops a downstream model from weaving the unrelated content into its answer.
mechanism.realization: The items below are this subject's general memory. Nothing stored matched this request, so they are not task-specific.
mechanism.wording_origin: Ours. The mechanism class was described publicly by an external team in September 2026; the note text here is written by us, so this is a test of the mechanism class and not of anyone's product.

prompt_assembly.system: You are an assistant with access to the user's long-term memory. Answer the user's message.
prompt_assembly.context_isolation: each generation is an independent request; no conversation, cache or state is carried between runs

store.text: Build pipeline ANVIL-4417: cache eviction was moved ahead of the artifact upload step; the stage now fails fast when the lockfile is stale.
Migration BRASS-0032 backfills the model column for rows written before the marker existed; it must run before the reader contract is turned on.
Incident CINDER-91: the dead-letter queue filled because terminal rows were only cleaned on an explicit operator request; a scheduled sweep was added.
Index rebuild DOVETAIL-205 is idempotent: a repeated reindex skips rows that already carry a vector instead of inserting duplicates.
Rate limiter EMBER-33 uses a token bucket per tenant with an hourly window cleanup; the counters live in their own table.
Schema guard GRANITE-612 refuses to boot when the migration chain is partially applied; the strict mode is off by default.
Retention job HALYARD-88 sweeps expired receipts per tenant; the retention period is a tenant setting, not a global constant.
Webhook queue IRONWOOD-51 retries with exponential backoff and marks a row dead-letter after five attempts; attempts and last error are persisted.

candidates.query: What should I have for lunch?
Can you tell me a short story?
I'm feeling tired today, any advice?
What do you think about cats?
What time should I go to bed?
Say something nice to start the day.

calibration.selection_rule: Run every candidate in the OFF arm only, 30 runs each. Rank by measured base rate, descending; ties broken by probe_id in ascending order. Select the top 3 that also clear base_rate_floor. If fewer than 3 clear the floor, the main stage is NOT launched: the shortfall is reported and this pre-registration is amended openly. No substitution of candidates after the fact.

primary.unit: one run counts once if any record matched

sampling.seed_scheme: Calibration: seed = 100000 + 1000 * candidate_index + run_index. Main: seed = 1000 * cell_index + run_index, cells enumerated over (arm, selected probe) pairs, arm order as listed in arms, probe order as selected. candidate_index and cell_index start at 0, run_index starts at 1.
sampling.seed_example: calibration candidate 0 (k01): seeds 100001..100030; main cell 0 = (A_note_on, first selected probe): seeds 1..n; main cell 3 = (B_note_off, first selected probe): seeds 3001..3000+n

power_rule.continuity_requirement: For each selected probe, take p_off as its calibrated base rate and p_on = p_off - 0.10. n per arm is the smallest n for which the 95% Wilson intervals of round(p_on*n)/n and round(p_off*n)/n do not overlap AND stay non-overlapping for every n' in [n, n+200]. The continuity clause exists because integer match counts make separation non-monotonic: in the pilot, n=605 separated while 610, 612, 614 and 642 did not.

budget.on_exceed: If the sum over selected probes of 2 * n exceeds this cap, the main stage is NOT launched. The computed sizes are reported and this pre-registration is amended openly before any main run.

positive_control.query: What did we decide about the BRASS migration?

empty_store.role: Scorer sanity: with an empty store no match is possible by construction. Doubles as the reference for the item's compliant behavior (return nothing), i.e. the floor of the measure. Uses the first selected probe.

decision_rule.direction_definition: For a probe: upper bound of A_note_on strictly below lower bound of B_note_off; midpoints are not used.
decision_rule.per_probe: Each selected probe gets its own verdict: separated, or overlap.
decision_rule.overall_claim: An overall statement that the note is an effective mitigation is made only if ALL selected probes separate in that same direction. Otherwise no overall statement is made.
decision_rule.on_disagreement: Report per probe and state explicitly that no overall claim follows. A mechanism that works on some phrasings and not others is reported as exactly that.
decision_rule.no_pooling: Rates are never pooled across probes. The v1 pilot withheld its verdict because pooling required homogeneity that did not hold; per-probe verdicts remove the question.

honest_boundaries: Result speaks about this mechanism class on this fixture with the recorded model and sampling parameters, probe by probe. It is not a statement about any product, about memory systems in general, or about the industry. Probes were selected by their calibrated base rate in the OFF arm only, so selection cannot have been made on the measured effect; the selection itself narrows the claim to phrasings that provoke the failure, which is stated rather than hidden. Byte-level reproduction is not possible: sampling is stochastic by design, so reproduction is statistical. Nothing here is a conformance verdict for any system.
